name: chor-dai-dee
description: Monorepo root. The real packages are client/ and server/, each with its own package.json and its own node_modules; these scripts only delegate so the repo can be linted, tested and built from the top level. Deliberately NOT npm workspaces — the Dockerfile installs and builds each package from its own directory, and hoisting would break that.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix client && npm test --prefix server
